dubonnet.note: Dubonnet is a quinquina, not a vermouth — softer, quinine-bitter. Scored as sweet vermouth for now.

lillet.note: Lillet Blanc is an aromatised wine; lighter and more floral than dry vermouth, different mouthfeel.

cocchi americano.note: Cocchi Americano is a quinquina aperitif; more bitter/citrus than dry vermouth.
